caption: The drawing depicts a puppet figure with a head, hands, and a draped body. The head is painted in a reddish-brown color with black hair and facial features including black eyes, eyebrows, and a smiling mouth, with some pinkish areas on the cheeks. The puppet wears a cap or bonnet, colored in an off-white or light grayish tone, which covers part of the hair. The arms are extended outward and appear to be made of a wooden material, rendered in a brown color. The main body of the puppet is covered by a loose, voluminous gown that reaches the ground, colored in an off-white or light cream shade and decorated with numerous evenly spaced red polka dots. The background of the drawing is plain and uncolored, focusing attention on the puppet itself. The artist’s signature, “Strother Harris,” appears in small, lightly printed text at the lower right area of the image.
title: Child of Punch and Judy
